js.home: const cate=env.get("category"); const page=parseInt(env.get("page")||"1"); const url=page<=1?`${env.baseUrl}/show/${cate}-----------/`:`${env.baseUrl}/show/${cate}--------${page}---/`; const html=await (0,utils_1.req)(url); const out=[]; const reg=/<a\b([^>]*?)href=["'](\/GV\d+\/?)["']([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi; let m; while((m=reg.exec(html))!==null){ const attrs=(m[1]||"")+" "+(m[3]||""); const body=m[4]||""; const id=m[2]; let title=""; let mm=attrs.match(/\btitle=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) title=mm[1].trim(); if(!title){ mm=body.match(/<img\b[^>]*\balt=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) title=mm[1].trim(); } if(!title){ title=body.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(); } let cover=""; mm=body.match(/<img\b[^>]*(?:data-src|data-original|src)=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) cover=mm[1]; if(cover.startsWith("//")) cover="https:"+cover; else if(cover.startsWith("/")) cover=env.baseUrl+cover; let remark=""; const rm=body.match(/(?:pic-text|remarks|module-item-note|video-serial)[^>]*>([^<]+)/i); if(rm) remark=rm[1].trim(); if(title && !out.some(x=>x.id===id)) out.push({id,title,cover,remark}); } return out
js.search: const wd=env.get("keyword"); const page=parseInt(env.get("page")||"1"); const url=`${env.baseUrl}/search/${encodeURIComponent(wd)}----------${page}---/`; const html=await (0,utils_1.req)(url); const out=[]; const reg=/<a\b([^>]*?)href=["'](\/GV\d+\/?)["']([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi; let m; while((m=reg.exec(html))!==null){ const attrs=(m[1]||"")+" "+(m[3]||""); const body=m[4]||""; const id=m[2]; let title=""; let mm=attrs.match(/\btitle=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) title=mm[1].trim(); if(!title){ mm=body.match(/<img\b[^>]*\balt=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) title=mm[1].trim(); } if(!title) title=body.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(); let cover=""; mm=body.match(/<img\b[^>]*(?:data-src|data-original|src)=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) cover=mm[1]; if(cover.startsWith("//")) cover="https:"+cover; else if(cover.startsWith("/")) cover=env.baseUrl+cover; if(title && !out.some(x=>x.id===id)) out.push({id,title,cover,remark:""}); } return out
js.detail: const id=env.get("movieId"); const url=id.startsWith("http")?id:`${env.baseUrl}${id}`; const html=await (0,utils_1.req)(url); let cover=""; let mm=html.match(/<img\b[^>]*(?:data-src|data-original|src)=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*alt=["'][^"']+["']/i); if(!mm) mm=html.match(/<img\b[^>]*(?:data-src|data-original|src)=["']([^"']+)["']/i); if(mm) cover=mm[1]; if(cover.startsWith("//")) cover="https:"+cover; else if(cover.startsWith("/")) cover=env.baseUrl+cover; let desc=""; mm=html.match(/<meta\b[^>]*name=["']description["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']*)["']/i); if(mm) desc=mm[1].trim(); const videos=[]; const reg=/<a\b[^>]*href=["'](\/playGV\d+-\d+-\d+\/?)["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi; let m; while((m=reg.exec(html))!==null){ const pid=m[1]; let text=(m[2]||"").replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(); if(!text) text=`第${videos.length+1}集`; if(!videos.some(x=>x.id===pid)) videos.push({id:pid,text}); } return {cover,desc,playlist:[{title:"播放",videos}]}
